items.request: Describe the registration call flow, then verify it on cluster B with the attach suite.
Restart it.
Handle ALM-0042 for me.
items.baseline_miss: The alarm id ALM-0042 does not match the word "alarm" and "handle" has no pattern, so the baseline has no signal and asks. A safe miss: a read-only investigation was the answer.

items.request: Look at cluster B.
items.baseline_miss: "Look at" has no pattern, so the baseline has no signal and asks instead of starting a read-only investigation of the cluster.

items.request: Check the attach test.
items.baseline_miss: "Check" could mean run the test again or look into its last result. The keyword "test" makes the baseline guess the testing agent.
